answer: The bond is locked for 58 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the tundra lockup is upheld by the river escrow, the jade audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large farm as a result freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. That is 19 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
